actions.mechanism: Traverse exactly IDs present at committed version S; later inserts are excluded, and later deletions return markers.
actions.implementation: Persist birth/deletion versions and serialize commit-fence publication. Index membership by immutable ID; atomically retain deleted membership for 24 hours. Sign ten-minute S/last-ID cursors.
actions.check: Under concurrent mutations, exhaust sessions: returned IDs must equal membership at S, with each appearing exactly once; measure requests against 300 ms.
actions.risk: Historical payloads are not promised; latest change versions alone cannot reconstruct membership.

actions.mechanism: Exclude post-start inserts; traverse remaining IDs in immutable-ID order, omitting records deleted before their page is selected.
actions.implementation: Capture a committed insertion-version ceiling. Use indexed keyset queries filtered by birth version, short per-request read transactions, and signed ceiling/last-ID cursors.
actions.check: Replay mutations against a reference model of each page’s read state; assert exact page IDs, zero duplicates, and requests within 300 ms.
actions.risk: This is not start-of-session completeness; clients must accept explicitly defined deletion omissions.

actions.action: Gate releases with adversarial traversal tests.
actions.mechanism: An independent membership ledger detects duplicates and skipped IDs without relying on page counts or overlapping samples.
actions.implementation: Seed 80,000 IDs; script six pages over two minutes, then exhaust. Mutate around cursor boundaries; test expiry, empty pages, and separately tracked retries.
actions.check: Assert sequence uniqueness and bidirectional set equality against the selected contract. Fail any request exceeding 300 ms under declared load.
actions.risk: Finite tests cannot prove latency universally; repeat with production-representative deletion density and concurrency.
